title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 5 — WORLD 5: B1+ CHALLENGE & INDEPENDENT ENGLISH
description: A high-density B1+ progression that pushes learners toward more precise grammar, richer vocabulary, longer texts, faster listening, independent opinions, presentations, problem solving and flexible real-world communication.

missions.title: B1+ Vocabulary Accelerator
missions.focus: advanced collocations, phrasal verbs, word formation, shades of meaning and vocabulary through context

missions.title: Grammar Precision Lab
missions.focus: tense contrast, perfect forms, narrative structures and selecting grammar by communicative purpose

missions.title: Reported Speech Mission
missions.focus: reporting statements, questions, requests and instructions while managing tense and pronoun changes

missions.title: Passive & Causative Starter
missions.focus: passive structures in news and everyday English plus introductory have/get something done

missions.title: Conditionals & Hypothetical Thinking
missions.focus: zero, first and second conditionals with practical consequences, advice and imaginative scenarios

missions.title: Gerunds, Infinitives & Verb Patterns
missions.focus: common verb patterns, meaning differences and accurate production in natural sentences

missions.title: B1+ Connectors & Discourse
missions.focus: however, whereas, therefore, despite, in contrast, as a result, on the other hand and sequencing language

missions.title: Society, Culture & Identity
missions.focus: traditions, communities, identity, cultural differences and respectful comparison

missions.title: Science, Discovery & Innovation
missions.focus: explaining processes, discoveries, inventions, evidence and cause-and-effect relationships

missions.title: B1+ Conversation Lab — Twelve Minutes
missions.focus: independent conversation with follow-up questions, clarification, examples, comparisons and extended opinions

missions.title: Reading Challenge — A Changing World
missions.focus: 1000–1200 word B1+ article with inference, attitude, reference, paraphrase and vocabulary-in-context tasks

missions.title: Listening Challenge — Fast Everyday English
missions.focus: 9–11 minute listening with natural speed, connected speech, multiple speakers, implied meaning and attitude

missions.title: Writing Lab — Structured Argument
missions.focus: 280–330 word opinion or for-and-against essay with thesis, reasons, examples, counterpoint and conclusion

missions.title: Presentation Lab — Explain, Compare, Persuade
missions.focus: 5–6 minute presentation using signposting, examples, comparisons, visuals and confident delivery

missions.title: Real-Life English — Customer & Service Problems
missions.focus: complaints, refunds, misunderstandings, escalation, polite firmness and solution-focused communication

missions.title: Real-Life English — Study & Future Work
missions.focus: applications, schedules, responsibilities, interviews, workplace requests and explaining experience

missions.title: Debate Lab — Build a Strong Case
missions.focus: state a position, support it with reasons, respond to opposing ideas, qualify claims and reach conclusions

missions.title: Complex Problem-Solving Simulation
missions.focus: process several pieces of information, identify constraints, compare options, negotiate and justify a final solution

missions.title: B1+ Integrated Skills Marathon
missions.focus: high-intensity review across vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking, writing, pronunciation and real-life English

missions.title: WORLD 5 MASTER QUEST — B1+ INDEPENDENT ENGLISH
missions.focus: final integrated B1+ challenge combining fast listening, long reading, argument, debate, presentation, practical communication and extended writing

content_targets.core_vocabulary: 1200+ active words, collocations, phrasal verbs, word families and functional language chunks
content_targets.reading: 1000–1200 word B1+ texts with inference, attitude, paraphrase and critical-reading tasks
content_targets.listening: 9–11 minute natural-speed multi-speaker listening with implied meaning and attitude
content_targets.speaking: 12-minute sustained conversation plus a 5–6 minute structured presentation and debate tasks
content_targets.writing: 280–330 word structured argument, opinion or for-and-against writing
content_targets.mastery: Learner demonstrates strong B1+ control by communicating independently, adapting language to situations, understanding natural spoken English, building arguments, handling disagreement, solving multi-step problems and producing organized extended speech and writing.
